# R Packages Used in This Book {#sec-packages}

Every chapter uses the tidyverse. A few chapters need one or two more packages.

| Chapter | Packages besides the tidyverse | Used for |
|----------------|--------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| @sec-jet | None | |
| @sec-recon | `stringdist`, `knitr` | Matching narrations, and tables |
| @sec-tenderflags | None | |
| @sec-bidrig | None | |
| @sec-bidshape | `ranger` | A random forest for bid rigging |
| @sec-payables | `stringdist` | Matching vendor names |
| @sec-payroll | `stringdist` | Matching names across two lists |
| @sec-revenue | `stringdist`, `igraph` | Matching addresses, and finding dealers trading in a circle |
| @sec-ssyaudit | `arules`, `sf`, `tidytext`, `knitr` | Association rules, maps and text |

: Packages used in each chapter {#tbl-packages}

## Installing the packages {#sec-packages-install}

The command below installs all of them. It needs an internet connection, and may take a while the first time.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "stringdist", "knitr", "ranger", "igraph",
                   "arules", "sf", "tidytext"))
```
:::


If your office network blocks downloads, see the note on installing packages in [*R for Audit Analytics*](https://anilyayavar.github.io/new-book/99-packages.html). The packages of that book cover all of these.
